title: [Godot 4.4] Moving a node from one SubViewPort node to another one crashes the game
body:
### Tested versions

- Works in Godot 4.3 mono
- Crashes in Godot 4.4 mono 
- Crashes in Godot 4.4 RC1 mono 

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.rc1.mono - Windows 11 (build 22631) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated Radeon RX Vega (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 31.0.21921.1000) - AMD Ryzen 9 3900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads)

### Issue description

In my networked game, I have a godot server that create one SubViewPort per map.  It allows me to handle multiple "worlds" in one godot server instance.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d07a3969-1589-4208-aeb9-4d2bf0ba12b2)

The code is as simple as this:

```
var mapNode = myMapScene.Instantiate();

var viewport = new SubViewport();
viewport.Name = mapId.ToString();
viewport.OwnWorld3D = true;
viewport.AddChild(mapWorld);

this.AddChild(viewport);
```

This works perfectly, and I can add my player in the map I want with `mapNode1.AddChild(entity).`

The problem occurs when the player want to teleport from map 1 to map 2 using portals. On server side, to achieve this, I just remove the player from the map 1 subviewport tree, and then add it later to map 2 subviewport tree. I don't queue free the initial entity.

That was working with no problems in Godot 4.3, but it crashes on Godot 4.4:

```
[GAMESERVER] Removing entity 2_player_Makita from tree 1
[GAMESERVER] Adding entity 2_player_Makita in tree 2

Fatal error. 0xC0000005
at Godot.NativeInterop.NativeFuncs.godotsharp_method_bind_ptrcall(IntPtr, IntPtr, Void**, Void*)
at Godot.NativeCalls.godot_icall_3_828(IntPtr, IntPtr, IntPtr, Godot.NativeInterop.godot_bool, Int32)
at Godot.Node.AddChild(Godot.Node, Boolean, InternalMode)
at ServerGameHandler.AddEntityInMap(LivingEntity, Int32)
at ServerGameHandler+<HandleHelloWorldRequest>d__25.MoveNext()
```

I just do `mapNode2.AddChild(entity)` after the teleportation => crash.

I fixed the issue by calling queue_free() on the old entity and re-instantiating it in Map 2 after teleportation. I'm still reporting it in case others encounter the same problem.
